notes.title: Star Singularity Beta Update
notes.content:
[p][b]Star Singularity Beta Update – A Big Step Forward (But Not Quite 0.9 Yet)[/b][/p][p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]I really pushed hard to get a major update out by the end of this month—crunching like crazy, even bringing on a writer to help finish the story. But the truth is, I didn't make it across the finish line. There are still hundreds of small things to fix and polish—crafting, enemy drops, shop systems—and I don’t want to release an update with missing core systems (Crafting).[/p][p]That said, I [i]am[/i] proud of how much progress has been made. The game is evolving faster than ever, and for the first time, the road ahead is [i]clear[/i]. We’re not lost in the stars anymore—we’re charting a course to something truly great.[/p][p]So here’s where we’re at:[/p][p][/p][p][b]A new Beta version is now live![/b]
You can try it out right now by switching to the Beta branch. There’s a new [b]Creative Mode[/b] option in the Gameplay Settings—turn it on to access every item in the game. Be warned: some of them are still broken or unbalanced. But it’s a fun way to explore what’s coming.[/p][p][b]What’s next?[/b]
Version 0.9 is coming soon. I promise it will be a major leap forward, and it won’t be much longer. Thank you all for your support, patience, and encouragement—it means everything.[/p][p]Stay curious, stay brave,
[b]– The Star Singularity Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Upcoming Update 🌌
notes.content:
We’re excited to share our upcoming update for Star Singularity, launching next month!

🛠️ What's New:

🔥 3 Epic Void Boss Fights – Face powerful new challenges from the heart of the Void.

⚔️ New Weapons & Items – Expand your arsenal with fresh tools of destruction.

🤝 Uniting the Factions – Each major faction will send you on a unique mission to rally the galaxy.

♿ Accessibility Options – Making the game more playable for everyone.

🌌 Galaxy Diversity Boost – More variety in galaxy generation for richer exploration.

📝 Improved Item Descriptions & New Sounds.

We're working hard to bring Star Singularity to its full potential – this update is a major step toward the finished game.

Thank you for being part of this journey!

– The Star Singularity Dev Team 🚀

notes.title: Star Singularity Update 0.8
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to bring you the latest update for Star Singularity, packed with exciting new features and enhancements to elevate your interstellar adventures! Here's what's new:

[list]
[*] Steam Deck Support – Take your adventure anywhere with full compatibility!
[*] Leveling & Tech Points – Level up, unlock new abilities, and shape your journey.
[*] Starport Missions – Embark on thrilling new challenges and storylines.
[*] Stability & Quality of Life Improvements – Smoother gameplay, better than ever.
[/list]
We're working tirelessly to bring Star Singularity closer to completion. In our next update, we’re diving into the epic conclusion of the Empress and the Void storyline, as well as adding dynamic elements to make the galaxy feel truly alive.

Thank you for being part of this journey and for your continued support. Together, we’re creating something stellar! 🌌

notes.title: Version 0.7.5 update (on beta)
notes.content:
Hi all,
We are very happy to officially announce 0.7.5 is up on the beta!
A lot of requested features have been added and bugs fixed.
[b]Achievements [/b]are finally here!

You can also play with [b]controller[/b], controlling not only the ships but the menus opening the inventory and switching to the different screen with the shoulder buttons. 

We also added a fun little mini-game based on the survivor trend, it is still very much work in progress but already fun! FYI items like shields stack on top of each other, so if you get an item with lower stats it will be added on top of the other items you already have! We are going to combine this mini-game in the main game in the form of arena challenges.
  
As always we will be happy to get your feedback.

Thanks for your support ː8bitheartː

Patch notes version 0.7.5:
[list]
[*]   Steam achievements.
[*]   Partial controller support.
[*]   Hotkeys for loot, stuck and equip items from inventory.
[*]   A game mode inspired by vampire survivor(See main menu).
[*]   GUI Scaling 
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Update - June 2021
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

This is a smaller update which adds a quality of life features that were requested.

[h3]Auto Equip[/h3]
[list]
[*] Auto Equip will equip your ship from items from your inventory and docked ship inventory
[*] Auto Equip helps equip new ships quickly from items stored in the mothership
[/list]
[h3]New Gameplay Option[/h3]
[list]
[*] New option under settings
[*] Contains two new options currently, 'Absolute Control' and 'Auto Save'
[/list]
[h3]Absolute Control Navigation Feature[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enables the absolute control scheme on all ships
[*] If enabled, engines will move the ship in the direction according to the screen and not the ship rotation,
[*] Note, this requires 4 engines, one on each side of the ship to function correctly. Otherwise you will need to use the 'Move to cursor' (default Space) button to navigate properly
[/list]
[h3]Auto Save[/h3]
[list]
[*] Allows auto save to be disabled and enabled
[*] Make sure to save manually when you need to
[*] Will not stop regular checkpoint saves from occurring
[/list]
[h3]Codex Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Implemented a preliminary codex UI
[*] This will contain info logs of events and subjects within Star Singularity
[*] Entries will be provided over time as the player explores the world and encounters events
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Scrolling a window with the mouse wheel will now only effect the window the cursor is hovering over, and not all windows
[*] Sorting has been improved to not just remove spaces in the inventory and stack items, but also to group up items/equipment by category type
[*]  Fixed 'Key Binding' bug with binding menu (The F keys)
[/list]

We are working hard on the next update that is going to be a major one! 
It will include achievements and trading cards and major plot update! 

As a heads up, the next major update is going to invalidate saves again. This is due to the overhauling of the main game universe that can't be avoided. We're focusing to make sure though that all of your items and equipment can be kept to make it back to where you were.

Thank you for the support.

notes.title: Make it so update
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

This is a major update to the game, overhauling multiple areas that have needed attention for a while. We'll try to list everything here.

[b]As a warning, this patch will invalidate all previous save files.[/b]

We will try and do something about this in the future (such as stashing all items to be retrieved in a new game), but for now this was unavoidable. Our apologies on this. 

[b]Storyline & Plot[/b]
[list]
[*] All text for the storyline for the prologue and first system have been redone
[*] Plot is more consistent than past iterations
[*] More story elements in the mission details and dialogue
[/list]

[b]Tutorial[/b]
[list]
[*] Integrated into the prologue and first system via the storyline
[*] Introduces new interfaces and game mechanics in a gradual manner
[/list]

[b]Missions[/b]
[list]
[*] Now shows an 'Active Quest' log in the top left corner
[*] The Mission tab now has additional details per mission by hovering over it
[*] Additional missions have been added
[/list]

[b]Codex (New, WIP)[/b]
[list]
[*] Contains previously completed missions
[*] Will be expanded to include lore and other information within the universe
[/list]

[b]Instant Action - Skirmish ! (WIP)[/b]

[list]
[*] A fleet vs fleet battle, with first to 20 frags
[*] Allows up to to 6 ships on each side to battle with pre-determined loadouts
[*] Planning to be expanded in the future to allow customized ships
[/list]

[b]Instant Action - Wave Challenge (WIP)[/b]

[list]
[*] You vs waves of incoming ships
[*] Enemies get stronger with each wave
[*] Enemies also drop consumables, items, and money to help boost you up
[*] To be balanced and expanded in the future
[/list]

[b]Settings[/b]
[list]
[*] Key Bindings - Cleaned up the interface with clearer labels
[*] Music Volume - Reduced the volume to be in line with the effects volume
[*] Dialogue Volume - Has been removed as the entire plot has been overhauled
[*] New Game - Now has a difficulty setting to determine if inventory drops on death
[*] Skip Tutorial - Can now skip all missions in the first system
[/list]

[b]Fixes and Quality of Life Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Auto Equip - Can now auto equip items by right clicking them from any inventory or the crafting tab.
[*] Crafting Stations- Now work from the inventory, or the inventory of the Mothership. No need to deploy them anymore.
[*] Death Marker - Dying when inventory drops on death will leave a marker to indicate where the player last died.
[*] Ship Names - Now shows more detail when hovering over it, such as the tech tier of the ship.
[*] Ship Hulls - Now are faction specific, with some factions favoring certain weapons.
[*] Equipment Details - Added/updated flavor text, spelling, descriptions to most equipment, with additional stats listed.
[*] Fleet Orders - Allied ships will retain their previous fleet orders.
[/list]

There are other fixes and changes, but these are what we can remember. If there are any suggestions or bugs, please report them in the Discord.

notes.title: 3... 2... 1... Ludicrous Speed Engaged!
notes.content:
Hello all, I plan to update the game on Monday the 8th of March. 

So what's in the update? The main change is that enemies are now designed to be beatable with skill or counter-play instead of relying more heavily on RNG.

We have added/changed few weapons that can be countered by the player:
* Artillery is a new weapon, and the blast area can be seen before it hits, so it can be avoided.
* Time bomb is a new weapon that can be destroyed before it explodes.
* Homing missiles can now be outmaneuvered if you are fast enough.

Some of the other items we are adding enable different type of play:
* Repair beam
* Energy draining drones (need a better name)

Other changes/fixes are:
* Cloaking now works with Vacuum Modulator
* Cloaking is now an upgrade to shields (via imbuing station)
* New graphics for starport and crafting stations

Full patch notes will be released with the update.

Thank you all for your support and your patience :)

notes.title: Imbue Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33033407/9faf0d2ffb6bb683e99a017b9f2a89e9130bd509.jpg[/img]
You can now add abilities to your shield and generators by using the imbuing station.
The abilities are passively triggered and are on cooldown. 

Some of the abilities are:
Avenging Missiles: 
Ability: Shots 20 homing missiles 
Tigger: Damage to hull

Berserk
Ability: Greatly increase energy generation for 20 sec 
Tigger: On low hitpoints

EMP
Ability: Stun nearby enemies for 8 sec 
Tigger: Low energy

Lifeline
Ability: Restores hitpoints and shield
Tigger: On low hitpoints

The next major update 0.5 “The Galaxy is Your Sandbox” is going to expand the sandbox elements of the game (Enemies, Items, Crafting, Boss fights, Etc..)

Bug fixes:
  * Deployed crafting stations don't cause a crush when trying to craft

  completed 

Changes:

  * Fixed screen transitions

We will keep the updates coming, hopefully with less urgent issues and more content :)

Enjoy.
